_comment: Authoritative method/item inventory, generated from the codex binary itself:
codex app-server generate-json-schema --experimental --out <dir>
Committed so CODEX_METHOD and the item mapper are pinned against a real
contract instead of guessed spellings, and so a codex upgrade shows up as a
diff on this file rather than as a runtime 'method not found'.
2026-08-10 CORRECTION (serverRequest family only, same codex build): the list
was wrong in both directions. It carried 'openai/form', which is not a method
at all but the `mode` enum inside McpServerElicitationRequestParams, and it
omitted the two legacy approval requests applyPatchApproval /
execCommandApproval. ServerRequest.json declares ELEVEN variants; ten were
recorded here. The two legacy names are appended at the END rather than sorted
in, matching the tail of the generated oneOf. The other two families are known
to be under-sampled the same way (clientRequest 126 vs 121, serverNotification
missing error/warning/configWarning/deprecationNotice/guardianWarning) and are
deliberately NOT touched by this correction (S3 slice 4 spec L6).
2026-08-17 BACKFILL (D48 S4, spec D14 / legacy L9): the two under-sampled
families named in the 2026-08-10 note are now complete against the SAME codex
build. clientRequest 121 -> 126 (initialize, fuzzyFileSearch,
thread/inject_items, thread/increment_elicitation, thread/decrement_elicitation)
and serverNotification 65 -> 70 (error, warning, configWarning,
deprecationNotice, guardianWarning). Both directions were re-diffed: nothing
recorded here disappeared from the binary, so this is pure under-sampling
closing, not a protocol change. Regenerated with the command at the top of this
comment; entries are sorted, unlike the 2026-08-10 serverRequest tail.
It lands with S4 because S4 is the slice that adds thread/settings/update to
CODEX_METHOD, and the rule is fixture first, method table second.
2026-08-26 UPGRADE 0.145.0 -> 0.149.1 (codex upgrade ticket, packaging spec 3.1
rule: re-run blessing, re-diff this snapshot, re-audit fixture shape assumptions).
Regenerated with the command at the top against the newly pinned binary. The diff
is PURELY ADDITIVE in all four families -- nothing recorded here disappeared:
clientRequest 126 -> 150 (+24: account/bedrock/discover, account/bedrock/setup,
externalAgentConfig/import/recordHistory, plugin/search, project/{create,delete,
import,list,move,read,update}, server/diagnostics, thread/queue/{add,delete,list,
reorder,start,update}, thread/revert, thread/section/move, threadSection/{create,
delete,list,update}) and serverNotification 70 -> 75 (+5:
autoApprovalReview/strictReviewRequired, project/changed, thread/project/updated,
thread/queue/changed, thread/reverted). serverRequest (11) and threadItemTypes (18)
are unchanged as sets, and the binary emits them in the same generated order as
before. serverRequest is stored below in this file's own convention (the nine
sorted, then the two legacy names appended), NOT in generated order -- that
convention predates this bump and is deliberately not changed by it.
The thread/revert + thread/queue/*
families are the upstream half of the queued fork/rollback idea -- see
docs/plantree/ideas/inbox.md.
